head: smooth_render

adopted.name: v4b
adopted.auc_is: the seed its own trainer staged, chosen on its pooled evaluation side rather than on this sheet
adopted.picked_is: the seed the adoption chose BY THIS SHEET'S OWN statistic — a selected maximum, which its adoption record says outright

resolution.what: five seeds of the adopted recipe, scored on this sheet. The spread is what the seed alone is worth, and a candidate has to survive the bottom of it.

declared_by_the_source: THE SEED PICK SPENDS A 197-ROW SELECTION. Sheet D was the only unanchored read of the minibrot population that will ever exist, and choosing among five seeds on it consumes it: the picked seed's 0.609 is a selected maximum, not a held-out number, and the band is the honest read of what a fresh seed would do. Nothing here is a held-out estimate of v4b/seed_1 any more.
ONE SLICE, ~200 ROWS. A null on sheet D is 'not distinguishable at this n', not 'identical'.
